_comment: Limits for the vultr cloud-init recipe target. Sized for the realistic floor (VC2-1c-2gb / VHF-1c-2gb, 2 GB RAM). Vultr's 1 GB tier sits below deputyOS minimum; the recipe README recommends 2 GB+. Schema in deputyctl/src/limits.rs.

limitations.reason: Vultr instances have no audio device; voice features disabled
limitations.unblock: deploy on rpi5 8GB+ or x86_64-mini-pc for voice

limitations.reason: We don't ship a signed Vultr snapshot; the cloud-init recipe pulls the deputyOS bundle at first boot
limitations.unblock: verify the recipe SHA before applying

limitations.reason: Updates are full re-image cycles (delete + redeploy)
limitations.unblock: scale up via Vultr API; deputyctl update prints redeploy instructions (M4)

limitations.reason: 2 GB RAM is too tight for clamd's ~900 MB RSS; on-demand clamscan replaces it
limitations.unblock: scale to 4 GB+ tier and re-enable in deputyctl config

limitations.reason: RAM tier 'low' (2 GB) far below local-LLM threshold (8 GB)
limitations.unblock: scale to High Frequency 8 GB+ or use a cloud model provider
